notes:
Summary of account / meeting notes:
- Company: Cedarline Works (mid-market SaaS powering in-app product analytics & contextual help).
- Primary stakeholders: Head of Product (A. Sokolov), Platform Eng (J. Meyer), Legal (K. Dubois).
- Business case: Replace current hybrid prompts + slow in-house LLM serving. Needs chat assistant for support workflows, embeddings for search, reranking for help articles.
- POC: 3-week hosted API POC completed. Used eu-west region; ingested 250k anonymised transcripts (customer insisted EU-only data during POC). POC findings: p50 chat = ~120ms, p95 = ~180ms with default batching; cost ~0.013 USD/token (hosted).
- Observations from POC: prefix cache reduced repeated prompt cost by ~22% for support flows; but KV cache locality caused a handful of tail latency spikes when routing across regions. Customer flagged need for cache affinity to EU region nodes.
- EU residency: Legal insists on EU-only residency + contract clause. They are open to Redwood Private but prefer Dedicated in a Redwood EU region first (predictable performance + easier procurement).
- Multi-region routing: Product team wants active-active across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 to reduce latency for EU customers. Ops team wants clear fallback policy (EU-only) — no failover to US unless explicit exception. Discussed possible geo-routing policy: prefer local EU region, fail closed to other EU zones, fail open to US only with approval (audit log required).
- Latency / perf tradeoffs: With Dedicated and local KV caching predicted p95 < 120ms; but cost rises ~30% vs hosted. Need exact quantization guidance (Llama-2-13B -> int8 recommended) and batching knobs. Redwood Optimize to produce configuration recommendations and estimated unit cost.
- Pricing: Two options on table: (A) Hosted with committed monthly spend + EU data residency addendum; (B) Dedicated reserved pool with 12-month commitment. Finance prefers Dedicated if annual ARR > 100k due to predictable unit costs. Still need final quote with committed throughput tiers.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, audit logging retention 7 years for some teams, KMS integration for envelope keys. Also asked about deletion/retention API for EU PII.
- SE notes (Luca): "Good fit for Dedicated; recommend 4-node pool with autoscale headroom 25% for peak support hours. Plan for canary rollout & A/B on model variants (13B vs 7B) to validate latency/cost tradeoffs."
- Legal comment (K. Dubois): "Need explicit data residency SLA and proof of region-level key storage (KMS in eu-central). Also want right to audit."
- Next steps: finalize Dedicated sizing + pricing; Redwood to send MSA addendum draft; tech workshop to validate KV cache affinity and geo-routing rules (propose week of 2026-03-17).
- Blockers: legal residency language, exact Dedicated price vs hosted committed, verifying p95 under 150ms in multi-region setup.
- Quick quotes from stakeholders: Product: "Latency is business-critical for support flows"; Platform Eng: "We cannot accept cross-border processing without legal sign-off".
